text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio continues to train day after day for her next race, the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, a press conference is held for the race participants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio proudly proclaims her intention of winning, but is followed quickly Mejiro McQueen, who also claims she will be victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sparks fly between the two ambitious racers as they prepare to face each other on the track.
